class.name: Box3DRagdoll
class.description: [Box3DRagdoll] builds Box3D server body RIDs for profile bones and connects them with module-internal native Box3D joints. Bodies of one ragdoll collide with each other — that contact is what lets a limb drape over the torso instead of folding through it — except directly jointed pairs and any pair listed in [member Box3DRagdollProfile.filter_pairs]; [Box3DRagdollProfileGenerator] pre-fills the pairs for joint neighborhoods and rest-pose overlaps. While inactive the generated bodies use kinematic-follow mode and cache physics poses from the parent [Skeleton3D]. Call [method build] when the character spawns so at least two physics poses are available before death. Calling [method die] seeds each body with finite-difference linear and angular velocity from those cached poses, optionally applies a hit impulse, and switches to physics write-back. Calling [method revive] returns to kinematic-follow. Typical setup is: select the node and use [b]Generate Profile...[/b] in its inspector, inspect the color-coded capsule and joint-limit gizmos, edit the chain-grouped capsule and limit values, use [member simulate_in_editor] to preview the result in an isolated physics space, assign the profile to the runtime character, call [method build] at spawn, then call [method die] on character death. The generation dialog discovers compatible meshes and animation libraries only inside the scene containing this exact node. Its target and undo history remain bound to that scene even if another editor tab or pane receives focus.

method.name: are_bodies_sleeping
method.description: Returns whether all generated Box3D bodies are sleeping.

method.name: build
method.description: Builds server body RIDs and native Box3D joints from [member profile]. Call this while the character is alive, preferably at spawn, so [method die] can inherit animation momentum from cached physics poses.

method.name: die
method.description: Switches to ragdoll mode. The current implementation seeds body velocities from the cached animation pose history and applies [param impulse] to [param hit_bone] when provided. If fewer than two cached physics poses are available, the method warns and inherited momentum may be zero. Driven ramping is reserved for a later milestone.

method.name: get_bone_body
method.description: Returns the PhysicsServer3D body RID for [param bone], or an invalid RID.

method.name: get_bone_global_transform
method.description: Returns the current global transform of [param bone]'s generated body.

method.name: get_bone_joint_parent
method.description: Returns the name of the bone [param bone]'s joint connects to after [method build], or an empty name for roots. Bodies are jointed to the nearest ancestor bone that is simulated in the profile, so bones skipped by the profile (helpers, unweighted rig bones) do not split the ragdoll.

method.name: get_bone_linear_velocity
method.description: Returns the current linear velocity of [param bone]'s generated body.

method.name: get_center_of_mass_velocity
method.description: Returns the mass-weighted average linear velocity of generated bodies.

method.name: is_built
method.description: Returns whether the runtime bodies and joints are built.

method.name: is_ragdoll_active
method.description: Returns whether physics write-back is active.

method.name: reset_simulation
method.description: Stops an editor-only private-space preview and restores the skeleton pose captured when simulation began. This method has no effect outside the editor.

method.name: teardown
method.description: Destroys native joints and generated server RIDs.

members.member: Profile used to build the ragdoll.

When enabled in the editor, snapshots the current skeleton pose and previews the ragdoll in a private Box3D space with a temporary ground plane. The property is editor-only and is not saved. Disable it or call [method reset_simulation] to restore the snapshot.

signal.name: ragdoll_asleep
signal.description: Emitted once after all generated bodies sleep while ragdoll mode is active.
